body: Sorry I just renamed that asset to Specular_3.svg it is in the ignored/ folder that will not show up in godot as it has a .gdignore in it to prevent the editor from importing it and crashing immediately. I re-uploaded and removed the no longer relevant import files.

Edit: Nevermind, i just opened the wrong project in my mrp directory, my bad.

@dirigonaut Could you edit the OP to add the svg files that cause the crash?

Tested and can confirm the crash, the issue was introduced in 4.3 RC 1, reverting pr #94258 fixes the issue. This didn't crashed before because you imported this images in 4.2 and 4.4 trigged it probably because the reimport required by uid changes.

Oh dope on finding the issue, glad to know I am not going crazy in that regard. Guess I will need to pull down the godot source code revert that change and then build a custom version for myself until a fix goes in for this? 

If it turns out to be less opaque then I might be able to put a fix in but a little wary of signing up for that before I know what it entails as it has been a minute since I programed in C++ and I don't want to introduce more errors.
I think this should be an issue with thorvg. I opened an issue in https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg/issues/3327.
This should have been fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105093 (in 4.5-dev3).
